additional_info.body:
Dear Claudia Kraft,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is Vikas, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: MP / R3 170001459
Charger ID/Serial No.: RA65MK
Problem Description: Unable to charge
Troubleshooting:   As you mentioned in the webform, there are three chargers that are affected and unable to charge. Could you please provide the serial numbers of these chargers and kindly provide us the date and time since you started facing this issue?
For future reference, your case number is 0397582, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0397582 - ID0397582-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001459] Unable to charge CRM:02023000390
additional_info.body:
Dear Claudia Kraft,
Hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the logs and observed that the charger is currently running on firmware v5.0.21, which contains some issues. These have been addressed and resolved in our latest firmware version.
May we proceed with updating the charger to the new firmware? After the update, you can try charging the device, and if you encounter any issues, please let us know so we can investigate further.
Thank you for your cooperation. We look forward to your response.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
